58bd92ff-8214-423e-9804-f97e6634827f.constraint:
context Person
inv ValidEmail:
    self.email.matches('^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$')

context Person
inv ValidPhoneNumber:
    self.phone_number.matches('^\\+?[0-9]{7,15}$')

62c286ad-9a0d-4195-bcdb-52fb70aa8ef1.constraint:
context Booking

inv CheckInBeforeCheckOut:
    self.check_in <= self.check_out

26bb3c59-68d9-4350-8cc4-e7295fbf5955.constraint:
context Booking
inv NumberOfGuestsDoesNotExceedRoomCapacity:
    self.guests->size() <= self.rooms->collect(r | r.max_people)->sum()
